subject: ProcureCo onboarding: redline MSA, portal choice, and PO routing
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma.li@procureco.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ProcureCo onboarding: initial MSA redline + portal questions

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the demo last week — excited to get Redwood activated in our procurement systems. Attached is our standard onboarding packet and a redlined MSA (see attachment: ProcureCo_Master_Services_MSA_redline.pdf). A few items we need to confirm before we start portal provisioning: 

- Which procurement portal do you prefer for production POs (Ariba vs Coupa)? ProcureCo supports both but needs supplier choice for field mapping.
- Do you accept PO routing via Ariba cXML or do you require SFTP/EDI? If SFTP, please provide cert fingerprint or preferred hostname.
- Order form fields we require: PO number, line-level GL code, tax jurisdiction, and invoice remit email. Any fields Redwood cannot populate?
- Signatory matrix: do we need C-level signature for the MSA or is VP Finance sufficient? We typically require an authorized signatory for vendor onboarding.

We also requested SOC 2 evidence in the checklist. If you can share a clean PDF or SOC 2 letter, that speeds our internal security gate.

Can you confirm a single point of contact for activation? Marissa — copying you to align on the AM/ops side.

Thanks,
Emma Li
ProcureCo — Supplier Onboarding
Attachments: ProcureCo_Master_Services_MSA_redline.pdf (application/pdf), ProcureCo_Onboard_Checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Emma Li <emma.li@procureco.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ProcureCo onboarding: initial MSA redline + portal questions

Emma — thanks for the packet. Quick answers up front so your team can continue provisioning: 

- Portal: Redwood prefers Ariba for our larger enterprise flows (we have a stable cXML mapping). We can support Coupa but will need a short mapping call for line-level GL.
- PO routing: Ariba cXML is preferred. For SFTP/EDI fallback, operations will provide hostname and cert; Jonas is on this thread and will share the fingerprint if you elect SFTP.
- Order form fields: we can populate PO number, tax jurisdiction, invoice remit email, and line-level GL. Note: GL mapping is maintained by Finance and occasionally uses internal tags that may not map 1:1 to ProcureCo fields — we’ll document the crosswalk.
- Signatory matrix: VP Finance can sign the MSA for commercial terms under $1M ARR. Anything above that requires EVP sign-off; let us know the anticipated contract value and we’ll confirm.

We will run the redline through legal, but two asks before we proceed:
1) Can you confirm the DocuSign route for the MSA (we prefer DocuSign + embedded signing) and
2) Please flag any mandatory escrow or audit clauses that deviate from your standard template.

Next steps from Redwood: I’ll hand to Kimberly for legal redline commentary, and Jonas will follow up with technical PO routing details. Marissa — will you schedule a 30-min mapping call (suggest Tues) to lock field mappings and the go-live window?

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

> Hi Markus,
> 
> Thanks for the demo last week — excited to get Redwood activated in our procurement systems. Attached is our standard onboarding packet and a redlined MSA...

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, Emma Li <emma.li@procureco.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ProcureCo onboarding: initial MSA redline + portal questions

Markus / Emma — scanning the redline. High level: ProcureCo’s edits are reasonable but we need to clarify three items before acceptance: 

1) Liability cap language (Section 5.2) — ProcureCo added a carve-out for data processing incidents that could push liabilities beyond the standard 1x fees cap. We propose: carve-out limited to direct damages arising from wilful misconduct or gross negligence only; exclude consequential and punitive damages as currently written.

2) Order Form binding: add a short sentence in the Order Form template that confirms field mapping shall not alter billing terms (i.e., GL code is for accounting classification only, not for fee changes).

3) Audit access: ProcureCo’s draft requests annual SOC inspection with live sysadmin access during audits. We’ll accept SOC 2 evidence and a scoped attestation but not live root access. Please update the audit clause to reflect certificate-based evidence or an on-site auditor with agreed scope.

I attached a response PDF with tracked-clause language (Redwood_MSA_response_markus_20250818.pdf). If ProcureCo is comfortable with those narrow edits we can proceed with DocuSign.

On the ops side, Jonas — can you share the SFTP cert fingerprint and whether Ariba cXML supports the custom "GL_Code" element (we can map internally if needed)?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_MSA_response_markus_20250818.pdf (application/pdf)

> On Fri, Aug 15, 2025 at 11:03 AM markus_klein@redwood.com wrote:
> > Emma — thanks for the packet. Quick answers up front so your team can continue provisioning:...

From: Emma Li <onboarding@procureco.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 15:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ProcureCo onboarding: initial MSA redline + portal questions

Thanks, Kimberly and team — really helpful. Quick responses: 

- Liability cap carve-out: acceptable as proposed. We’ll update our redline to limit the carve-out to willful misconduct / gross negligence and exclude consequential/punitive damages.
- Order Form binding: we’ll add the clarifying sentence that GL codes are for accounting only.
- Audit access: we can accept SOC 2 reports and a scoped on-site attestation. We will not require live root access — that was boilerplate.

We’ll upload an updated redline and create a DocuSign envelope for the revised MSA later today. DocuSign powerform link: https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormStart?env=na1&acct=12345678&PowerFormId=abcdef

Jonas — for SFTP the hostname will be sftp.procureco.com. If you can send the cert fingerprint we’ll whitelist it. Otherwise, we’ll provision Ariba cXML and share the supplier activation URL once mapping is complete.

Marissa — can you suggest three times for a 30-min mapping call this week? We’d like to aim for activation in the next 10 business days.

Best,
Emma Li
ProcureCo Onboarding
